model.maintenance: non-negative OLS: fixed + simulator maintenance cycles
model.reader: non-negative OLS: rounds + issued reader memory requests + reader metadata bytes + resident vertex domain
model.compute: non-negative OLS: rounds + issued compute memory requests + sparse-store scan words + processed edges
model.iterative_span: max(predicted reader, predicted compute) + non-negative per-round residual

model_selection_note: The independently frozen v5 batch-64 holdout failed because its batch-8-only model underrepresented source-service and cross-batch pipeline work. V6 retains the exact execution model and adds only counters mapped to routed HLS loops: reader/compute requests, metadata bytes, sparse-store scans, processed edges, rounds, and the previously identified routed vertex-domain floor. The failed v5 rows are development evidence in v6 and are never reported as holdout.
freeze_note: This contract, model form, thresholds, and exact AU/SU batch-512 workload hashes were frozen before either batch-512 workload was executed with the v6 simulator evidence path or FPGA holdout runner.
